summary: Verified preview-mode OIDC hardening + logout + identity-mappings for IronVision AI. 9/9 pytest backend tests PASS and all 6 UI acceptance points PASS. (1) Password login still works for demo@ironvision.ai. (2) POST /api/v1/auth/demo-login still works (200) → demo-login-btn on /login logs the user in and lands on the ISSO persona. (3) GET /api/v1/auth/oidc/login → 404, GET /api/v1/auth/oidc/callback → 404, POST /api/v1/auth/oidc/exchange {code:'x'} → 404 (oidc not in AUTH_PROVIDERS in preview). (4) POST /api/v1/auth/logout now returns HTTP 200 with JSON {"end_session_url": null} for password sessions and the session is revoked (subsequent /auth/me = 401). (5) /api/v1/admin/identity-mappings → 401 unauthenticated, 403 for ISSO persona, 200 with [] for platform_admin persona (via act-as). (6) Admin UI /admin (Phase3Extras) shows [data-testid=identity-mappings-panel] with [data-testid=identity-mappings-empty] visible, read-only (no Create/Add/New button inside the panel). (7) /login?oidc_error=idp shows [data-testid=oidc-error] with text 'Single sign-on did not complete. Please try again.'; without the param the alert is absent.

issues: Benign React warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop. Check the render method of AdminPhase3Panels.' — not visible to users, worth cleaning up a map() somewhere in Phase3Extras.
Pre-existing CSP console errors from Cloudflare beacon.min.js and blob-worker (platform-injected, unchanged).

action_items: (LOW) Fix the missing React 'key' prop in AdminPhase3Panels render (likely the panel list that now includes IdentityMappings).
critical_code_review_comments: OIDC gating via _require_oidc() -> 404 is correctly applied to /oidc/login, /oidc/callback and /oidc/exchange. Verified from the public ingress in preview (AUTH_PROVIDERS=dev_password).

logout now consistently returns HTTP 200 with {"end_session_url": <url|null>} regardless of provider, which fixes the previous 204 that could not carry the RP-initiated logout URL. For password sessions the body is {"end_session_url": null} — frontend AuthContext just needs to redirect to /login when null, which it already does.

admin.users.manage permission guard on GET /api/v1/admin/identity-mappings is correct — ISSO (default persona) is 403 and platform_admin is 200. Scoping to current.user.org_id is correct for multi-tenant isolation.
No create/update/delete endpoints exposed for identity mappings on the API; the UI panel also exposes no create buttons. Read-only contract honored on both sides.
Login page param handling (oidc_error=idp → oidc-error alert) is strict: only renders when the query param is present. Good.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview runs AUTH_PROVIDERS=dev_password with ALLOW_DEMO_LOGIN=true; Keycloak is NOT running in preview. The 11 live Keycloak pytests in tests/test_keycloak_live.py require a real Keycloak and must NOT be run here. Backend pytest should use -n 0 (xdist -n 2 has a known schema race). Admin identity-mappings endpoint is GET /api/v1/admin/identity-mappings (full prefix includes an extra 'admin' because the admin router routes are declared with '/admin/...' and mounted under '/api/v1').
